Happy 22nd anniversary, Mom & Dad.

Chapter one

Where it all began.

Jasmine garlands, silk and gold, and the day two people said yes.

Chapter two

A few of my favourite pictures of you two.

Hover or tap a photo to open it up · tap again to enlarge

Dear Mom and Dad,

You have never made a speech about love. You just kept doing it: the temple mornings, the trips, the evenings where nothing happened, and every photo where one of you is pulling a face.

Twenty-two years is a long time to choose the same person. You made it look easy, and I know it wasn’t. I’m lucky I got to watch.

Thank you for building the home I grew up in. I hope I find even half of what you two have.

With all my love.

Here’s to the next twenty-two.

Made for you, by your child.
